lines.en: Was Mrs. Rumbold a good companion at dinner?
lines.cn: 兰博尔德夫人在晚餐时是个不错的交谈伙伴吗？

lines.en: Last week at a dinner party,
the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs. Rumbold.
lines.cn: 女服务员让我坐在朗博尔德夫人旁边。
朗博尔德太太身材魁梧……

lines.en: unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
lines.cn: 那位面无笑容的女士穿着一件紧身的黑色连衣裙。

lines.en: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
lines.cn: 当我坐在她旁边时，她甚至都没有抬头看我一眼。

lines.en: Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time,
lines.cn: 她的目光紧紧盯着自己的盘子，不一会儿……

lines.en: 'A new play is coming to "The Globe" soon,'
lines.cn: 一部新剧很快将在“The Globe”剧院上演。

lines.en: I said. 'Will you be seeing it?'
'Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year?' I asked.
lines.cn: “今年你打算在国外度过假期吗？”我问道。

lines.en: 'Will you be staying in England?' I asked.
In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
lines.cn: 我有些绝望，便问她晚餐吃得怎么样。

lines.en: 'if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!'
lines.cn: “如果你多吃点、少说点话，我们俩的晚餐都会更愉快！”
